milestones.title: Target characterization
milestones.note: Exhaustive syscall survey (1838 probes), sysent boundary measured at 676 entries, 39 userland modules enumerated, CClosure redirect confirmed (56c/56f), thread ROP execution via thr_create(430) and thr_new(455), arbitrary userland calls via fcall_with_rax, C11 threading, UMTX PI mutex. 13.60 Ghidra decompile of set_mcontext validates thr_create panic root cause as kernel candidate.

checks.label: Baseline interface observations retained
Complete scoped survey with reconciled current summary
Native code execution primitive confirmed
Target-build analysis validates a kernel candidate

milestones.title: Kernel attack surface mapping
milestones.note: 12+ CVEs assessed against 14.10 (all blocked/stubbed). 123+ dead ends mapped with root causes. 34/76 device nodes inventoried, ioctl command space measured end to end (32M calls across 31 nodes). UMTX PI orphaned kernel waiter proven (274e/274f, 564a-571a). AIO delete race fully serialized (525a-562a). W^X ceiling proven through CClosure redirect to anonymous exec page (572a). physhm write claim independently refuted (DEM9N101). Exhaustive getsockopt sweep (214 opts, 8 socket types). dmem0-backed AIO destination discovered. 17 KASLR techniques tested, all dead.

checks.label: CVE and public technique assessment against target firmware
Systematic dead-end mapping eliminates blind alleys
Active kernel-touching primitive identified with exploitation path

milestones.title: WebKit / JSC attack vector
milestones.note: Second entry vector via browser engine. 26 JS probes, 12 findings documented. Browser entry via guide redirect demonstrated. FontFaceSet::load() UAF validated on 14.10 with 4/5 crash rate: style.remove() is the free, death is inside FontFaceSet::load(), two independent researchers confirmed (PR #149, issue #143 by lunarshe11). 518-case LayoutTests crash corpus replayed (Finding 9). MetadataTable integer overflow confirmed unpatched. Canvas reentrancy identified as next discriminating test. No demonstrated controlled corruption or arbitrary R/W from browser yet.

checks.label: Browser entry demonstrated on target firmware
Memory-safety vulnerability validated with crash rate data
Controlled corruption or R/W from browser

milestones.title: Exploit infrastructure
milestones.note: thr_new(455) and thr_create(430) both confirmed working. Thread budget measured (25/11/9 per loader). Child threads execute kernel syscalls via fn_addr ROP chains (274c). native.fcall_with_rax confirmed (getpid/socket/close). UMTX parking pattern for thread synchronization. AIO 669 independently verified by second researcher with dmem0 destination. sceKernelAllocateDirectMemory reachable from game sandbox via libkernel GOT wrapper (DEM9N101). 13.60 offline handler decode (22 functions decompiled). SDK v0.45 published 14.10 kernel offsets (allproc, security_flags, rootvnode).

checks.label: Threading and synchronization primitives operational
Arbitrary function call and gadget infrastructure ready
Offline kernel analysis provides exploitation targets

milestones.title: Validated 14.10 kernel vulnerability
milestones.note: FontFaceSet::load() UAF is a validated vulnerability on 14.10: 4/5 deterministic crash, root cause identified in WebKit source (weak refs in FontFaceSet::load vs strong refs in iterateClients), two independent researchers confirmed (PR #149, issue #143). UMTX orphaned waiter touches real kernel wait queue state (274e/274f), thread exit never disowns a PI mutex. Neither yet yields controlled kernel corruption, hence 5 not 10.

checks.label: Vulnerability root cause identified with controlled reproduction on 14.10
Controlled reproduction establishes kernel-level impact
